sentences.text: As seen from the material placed on record and the submissions made, it is clear that the detention order passed against Accused No.2 in the subject crime i.e., Crime No.100 of 2021 of Dummugudem Police Station was already set aside by this Court vide order dated 26.09.2022 passed in W.P.No.30481 of 2022.

Moreover, the impugned detention order was passed without adhering to the requirements/mandate given under Section 3(2) of the PD Act and by relying only on one crime registered for the offence punishable under Section 8(C) r/w 20(b) of the NDPS Act,
which does not add up to "disturbing the public order" and which is only a "law and order" problem.

Under these circumstances and since the facts and circumstances of the present case are akin to the facts and circumstances in W.P.No.30481 of 2022, the impugned orders are liable to be set aside.
6.
In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The impugned detention order vide Rc.No.C1/931/2022, dated 14.06.2022, passed by the respondent No.2, and the consequential confirmation order vide G.O.Rt.No.1613 dated 19.08.2022, are hereby set aside.
The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely, Mohammed Asfak S/o.Thahir, at liberty forthwith, in case he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
[ The Miscellaneous Petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
There shall be no order as to costs.
